priority: F01–F05 first; W01–W05 next; W06–W10 last. This adds to A01–E05 (25) and S01–S05 (5), total 45 planned tasks.

tasks.title: Simulation boot, clock and offline baseline
tasks.acceptance: Ensure ticks, pause/resume, game start and speed controls work with no network; no double ticker.

tasks.title: Survival needs and renewable resources
tasks.acceptance: Multi-seed Nim obtains food/wood/stone, can rest/build camp; renewals avoid permanent depletion.

tasks.title: Pathfinding goal fallback and safe traversal
tasks.acceptance: BFS goals have safe reachable fallback; no repeated impossible target; deterministic results.

tasks.title: NPC meetings, divine event accounting
tasks.acceptance: Three NPC cap, natural encounter, one-time Inspire, valid/rejected power Faith consistency.

tasks.title: Save, offline UI and 10k-tick stability
tasks.acceptance: Old saves restore with no changed tile IDs; 10k ticks and browser frame lifecycle pass.

tasks.title: Define deterministic region ID model
tasks.acceptance: All 3072 map cells receive one of R00–R07; same seed gives same result; terrain IDs unchanged.

tasks.title: Guarantee safe spawn, reachable starter supplies
tasks.acceptance: No enemy inside initial protection radius; berries/wood/stone reachable in seed sweeps.

tasks.title: Build and verify road and POI connectivity
tasks.acceptance: Start reaches two hamlets, two shrines and ≥1 ruin via BFS, visual roads match traversal.

tasks.title: Connect hamlet zones to existing NPC home roles
tasks.acceptance: Ira/Toren/Mera placements preserved; patrols and meetings bounded and observable.

tasks.title: Regional resource/danger weighting
tasks.acceptance: Forest/hills/fen identity meaningful; no unbounded spawns or inaccessible essentials.

tasks.title: Ruin/shrine region encounters and finite rewards
tasks.acceptance: Oathkeeper/Crownfall/Moonwell experiences have finite and save-safe discovery.

tasks.title: Region discovery, chronicle and minimap metadata
tasks.acceptance: Unknown areas stay fogged, titles reveal correctly, inspect and divine targeting coherent.

tasks.title: Region weather and activity flavor
tasks.acceptance: Distinct rain/wildlife/ambient cues do not alter world RNG on render or tank mobile FPS.

tasks.title: Save migration, seeded reconstruction and schema audit
tasks.acceptance: v1 save format preserved; pre-region saves work; 100 seed region membership tests pass.

tasks.title: Long-run QA and 2–3GB Android validation evidence
tasks.acceptance: 10k tick multi-seed suite, responsive 640x360 UI, Android 2/3GB RAM test or explicit block.
